title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis 2027: multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer. We would like to build the price basis on a longer commitment rather than an index clause.

Our forecast fc:370010@2026-09 records a +1.9% volume change for this part, which adds volume to your account. Our current contract ctr:4600070740 runs on 60 days payment, and we propose to keep that.

As a firm price with no index clause, we offer the attached 24- or 36-month packages. Because your 6.10 is about 4.5% above our current 5.84, we ask that your pricing committee review it. We would also welcome the cost walkthrough your owner offered, covering material and hourly rates.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis 2027: multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge the verified volume increase and are prepared to support a 24-month agreement with 60-day payment terms. 

Please understand that we cannot offer a fixed price over a multi-year period due to raw material volatility. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. By applying the AS-14404 index clause, we are able to offer a highly competitive base price of €5.70 per unit.

Our current Angebot features a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. For your reference, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
